en: Black‑and‑white historic street view of a Nordic town. On the right stands a large, ornate white public building with twin corner turrets, arched windows, balcony and broad steps. On the left is a row of 2–3‑storey wooden and masonry shopfronts along an unpaved main street with a few pedestrians. Handwritten notes label several buildings at the top of the image. Printed captions at the bottom read the town name on the left and the publisher's credit on the right.
